changelog:
Sending to your television works right after you come back to the app.

WHAT CHANGED

- If the app had been in the background, its connection to your
  PerchTV television could be down when you came back, and the first
  Send or Stop you pressed was lost without a word. Now the app
  reconnects as soon as you open it, and a Send or Stop pressed while
  it is still reconnecting waits and goes through when it is back. If
  the television cannot be reached within 15 seconds, the app says so
  and asks you to send it again.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including pairing, Stop on your television, the
  LIVE button, and recovery from dropped streams.
